content.short: Banana is a viral idle game on TON where players collect and sell rare digital bananas for rewards.
content.description: Banana is a highly engaging and viral idle game operating on the TON blockchain, powered by the Carv.io platform. Players participate by tapping on digital bananas to earn 'Peels' and have the chance to collect rare, uniquely generated digital bananas. These rare assets can be traded or sold for USDT within the ecosystem, providing a direct and fun way for users to earn rewards. With its simple mechanics and social-driven gameplay, Banana has successfully captured a massive audience, showcasing the power of gamified asset collection on TON.
content.meta: Collect rare bananas and earn rewards with Banana on TON. Play the viral idle game on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
